scrum_requests_review_state_check.name: scrum_requests_review_state_check
scrum_requests_review_state_check.value:
(
          "scrum_requests"."status" = 'pending'
          AND "scrum_requests"."scrum_id" IS NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "scrum_requests"."status" = 'approved'
          AND "scrum_requests"."scrum_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR (
          "scrum_requests"."status" = 'rejected'
          AND "scrum_requests"."scrum_id" IS NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "scrum_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

web_score_events_void_state_check.name: web_score_events_void_state_check
web_score_events_void_state_check.value:
("web_score_events"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "web_score_events"."void_reason" IS NULL AND "web_score_events"."voided_by" IS NULL)
          OR ("web_score_events"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "web_score_events"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "web_score_events"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL)
